star.description: The entry's star marker, as the game shows it.

worn.description: Either equipment set wears the item.

replayed.description: Natural because the game's generator reproduces the record from its own seed.

soul_core.description: A soul core, whose random effects are re-rolled keeping each slot's star marker.

EquipmentSeeds.description: runtime.equipment_seeds: how many of the 65536 seeds give the item every wanted effect, and the best of them.

generation.description: The difficulty the character is on and the progress of each difficulty an item could have dropped on (the equipment generator's player state).
